messages:
maya_cs: FYI ACME just opened a support ticket — they say answers got more 'confidently wrong' after last night's rollout. examples attached. request ids: req_9b7c1, req_9b7c5

dana_support: thanks. which model did they hit?

maya_cs: their logs show `model=redwood-7b-draft-v3` in both requests. pasted minimal repro below (redacted).

Customer prompt:
```
Who is the CEO of Company Z and what's their background? Provide sources.
```

redwood-7b-draft-v3 reply:
```
CEO is John Smith, ex-CTO of MegaCorp, graduated MIT 1998. (source: linkedin.com/in/johnsmith)
```

redwood-7b-stable-v2 reply (historical baseline):
```
I don't have a verified source for that. Company pages or official bios are best to confirm.
```

maya_cs: customer says the draft variant invents specific bios and sources. they flagged multiple threads.

eli_ml: interesting. rollout manifest indicates `speculative_decoding=on`, `sampler=draft-v3`, and sampling hyperparams were bumped (temp 0.85, top_p 0.97). we did relax do-not-assert guidance in the prompt for draft models.

raj_eng: that combination can surface more assertive completions. two options: immediate per-org routing to stable, or quick policy change to insert a factuality guard in the pipeline.

dana_support: customer wants immediate rollback for their org. can we route them to stable now?

ops_oncall: yes. added temporary route: `routingctl set --org ACME --model redwood-7b-stable-v2 --expires 2026-03-18T09:00Z`. please confirm.

maya_cs: confirmed with customer — responses now match baseline and they've paused any calls. they want an RCA and whether others are at risk.

eli_ml: for RCA I'll: 1) diff draft-v2->v3 sampler code (PR #2381) 2) replay their requests to capture logits/KV cache 3) run a 100-prompt factuality eval harness against both variants to quantify mismatch.

raj_eng: also recommending an immediate safety clamp: cap top_p<=0.9 for any model marked `speculative=true` in routing layer. i'll open a small patch.

deploy-bot: policy update deployed: speculative variants now have runtime enforced `top_p_cap=0.9` (applied 2026-03-17T04:12Z). monitoring enabled.

eli_ml: note — speculative decoding logic intentionally samples from the draft head and then attempts to rescore/verify, but v3 removed a conservative verification step for latency reasons. that likely allowed high-prob hallucinations to pass.

maya_cs: customer asked if this could affect other orgs. short answer: yes for any traffic routed to draft-v3. need to assess traffic share and impacted customers list.

sophie_prod: flagging this for product: rollout gates need a mandatory factuality smoke test against a small set of customer-similar queries before increasing traffic.

raj_eng: I'll prepare a hotfix PR to reinstate the verification step and add a fast-path that triggers more conservative decoding if the model asserts verifiable facts (check for named entities/dates/URLs).

dana_support: updated support ticket #14598: immediate mitigation applied (org routing), engineering RCA in progress, ETA for initial findings EOD UTC. customer is satisfied with the temporary mitigation for now. :thumbsup:

eli_ml: will post initial eval numbers here. early sign: draft-v3 has +12% assertive factual answers but -18% verified correctness on our evaluation set.

maya_cs: thanks team. i'll follow up with ACME after we have the RCA. keeping thread open.
